- Full Professor and Deputy Director of Research at EADA Business School (Barcelona). Research, teaching, and consulting in Purchasing & Supply Chain Management with a growing focus on environmental and social sustainability (incl. social impact supply chains and systemic change).
- Co-Editor-in-Chief, Journal of Supply Chain Management (2025-2027).
- Executive Committee member of IPSERA; Conference Chair (2023); Organizer of the annual IPSERA Doctoral Workshop (2013-2025).
- Research streams include sustainable SCM, public procurement, supply chain performance measurement, and post-growth/system-change perspectives.
- Extensive teaching across BSc/MSc/MBA/PhD and executive education; director/lecturer in multiple corporate programs since 2007.
- Accreditation: Acreditació de Recerca Avançada (Catedrático) AQU/ANECA n. 0233/1324/2018; two research evaluation periods (sexenios).

## Research areas
- Purchasing & Supply Management strategy; portfolio management; supplier involvement and innovation
- Sustainable supply chain management (environmental and social sustainability) and supply network transparency
- Social impact supply chains, systemic change, and post-growth SCM perspectives
- Public procurement strategy, organization, and performance management
- Supply chain performance measurement; supplier evaluation systems; supply network complexity
- Digital procurement and e-procurement; supply chain finance (research stream)
